original_benchmark.notes: 101 public tasks (HF namkoong-lab/MBABench-2.0, dataset v1.1). Upstream runs agents through four surfaces (GUI chat products, Excel add-ins, raw-API CLI agents, coding agents in Docker); this adapter reproduces the coding-agent surface (Claude Code / Codex, prompt template v13), the only one that maps onto Harbor's CLI agents. CLI versions are pinned per sandbox image upstream (e.g. Claude Code 2.1.251 / 2.1.280, Codex 0.150.1 / 0.155.1).

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity not yet run (plan pending team approval). Proposed: claude-code + claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, 3 runs per side on the 30-task `--split parity` subset; judge cost alone is ~$3.5 per graded attempt upstream (~$630 for 3 runs x 2 sides x 30 tasks).
